name: Auto Clean

features.text: Clean Building consumes Rooms-designated tiles in the current physical building. Clean Area uses confirmed rectangle/paint/erase/floor selection without saving designations.
Quartermaster SupplyAPI 1 fetches configured supplies and returns borrowed tools. Bucket preparation uses 10 mL bleach first, then water; native timings and server authority guards remain active.
Decorative ground-trash cleanup uses an eligible broom or vanilla pickup and preserves dropped inventory items. Vanilla current-action and separate whole-job progress bars remain available.
Approved transparent mop-and-bucket mod icon; original thumbnail and poster preserved.

limits: Source inspection and offline simulated-engine tests only. Actual SP/split-screen, mod-list rendering and dedicated multiplayer NOT TESTED. G7/stable G8 BLOCKED. Footprint/pathfinding/synchronization/rejoin/save/restart acceptance remains a runtime gate. Workshop distribution is not runtime proof.
